name: D-ribose
short: Human safety data are limited: an EFSA panel judged it safe up to 36 mg/kg body weight per day, and it was well tolerated in a small uncontrolled pilot study.
text: Human safety data are limited. A European Food Safety Authority panel concluded that d-ribose is safe for the general population at intakes up to 36 mg/kg body weight per day. In a small open-label, uncontrolled pilot study in 41 people with fibromyalgia or chronic fatigue syndrome, D-ribose was reported to be well tolerated. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
